requirements.criterion: A seeded admin using the correct synthetic password must reach the CRM dashboard.
An incorrect password must display Invalid credentials and keep the user on the login page.
A viewer must see the read-only accounts banner and the Export accounts button must be disabled.
A manager must have enabled Dashboard, Accounts, Opportunities and Reports navigation, with Leads and Admin users navigation disabled.
A sales user must see required-field validation before creating a lead with a name, email and source.
A manager must be able to create an opportunity with a name and numeric value.
A manager must be able to retry a failed revenue report and see that the report is ready.
The synthetic dashboard open-pipeline metric must display $842k.
